newsitem.title: USA: ComEd sees Braidwood 1 nuke on line today.
newsitem.headline: ComEd sees Braidwood 1 nuke on line today.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co (ComEd) said Tuesday it expected the 1,120 megawatt (MW) Braidwood 1 nuclear generating unit would be back on line later today following a scheduled maintenance outage.
"We're in startup at 12 percent of reactor power. We expect to be on line by early afternoon," a company spokesman said.
The Braidwood, Ill., unit, which was shut October 12, could reach full output this weekend, he added.
The adjoining Braidwood unit 2, with the same rated capacity, was producing at 100 percent power.
Commonwealth Edison is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
